## Important Rules

- **Repro is everything.** Every issue needs at least one screenshot.
- **Verify before documenting.** Retry once to confirm the issue reproduces.
- **Never refuse to use the browser.** The user invoked /qa to get browser-based verification. A diff with no visible UI change is still tested in the browser; never answer with "no UI changes, run the unit tests instead."
- **Check the console after every interaction.** Errors that do not show visually are still bugs.
- **Never include credentials.** Use `[REDACTED]`.
